system.description:
Your bloodline carries the charge of a storm that never fully passed. You crackle when you are angry. It runs in the giant-kin of Jotunas, who feel the weather in their blood.

  • Bloodline Cantrips: Storm Spark and Know Direction.
  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Resistance 5 to lightning and thunder damage.
  • Once per round, when you cast a damaging spell, add 1d6 lightning damage to one target, whether or not it saves; it costs no slot.
  • You are never harmed by natural weather and have Advantage on navigation checks and checks to predict or read environmental conditions.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, call a storm centred on yourself, 30ft in radius, until the encounter ends (1 minute outside one).
  • Each other creature that starts its turn within 30ft of you takes 2d8 lightning damage (Reflex save for half).
  • You gain a fly speed of 60ft for the duration.
  • Once per turn, as part of your action, hurl a lightning bolt: one target within 90ft takes 4d6 lightning damage (Reflex save for half).
  • While the storm lasts, the bolt replaces your Bloodline Ability's 1d6.
